aim.zh: 正因为她按部就班地实现一个个短期目标，她才会在科学领域获得不断的突破。

aim.en: The main aim of the course is to improve your writing.
aim.zh: 这一课程的主要目的是提高写作能力。

aim.en: It was because she realised short-term aims one after another step by step that she could make scientific breakthroughs constantly.
The aim of the research is to find new food sources.
aim.zh: 此项研究的目的是寻找新的食物来源。
把枪对准某人这个比赛旨在鼓励年轻人继承中华文化传统。

aim at.en: The factory will aim at increasing production next year.
aim at.zh: 工厂明年将以提高生产为目标。

air.en: Only when the government takes serious measures can we expect the real improvement in air quality.
air.zh: 只有政府采取严厉的措施，我们才有望看到空气质量的真正改善。

air.en: Let’s go outside and get some fresh air.
air.zh: 我们出去呼吸些新鲜空气吧。

air.en: He has decided to air his opinions.
You need to put some air in the tyres.

air.zh: 到空气质量的真正改善。

air-conditioned.en: Not until he went out of the air-conditioned room did he realise how cold it was today.
air-conditioned.zh: 直到他走出空调房间，才意识到今天有多冷。

airing.en: Put your houseplants outside to give them an airing.
airing.zh: 把室内盆栽植物搬出去透透气。

airline.zh: 他经营一家私人航空公司。

airport.en: to the airport to see his friend off.
airport.zh: 是因为他去了机场给朋友送行。

airport.en: Her family went to see her off at the airport.
The reason why Eric didn't come to the party yesterday was that he went to the airport to see his friend off.
airport.zh: 艾里克之所以没能出席昨天的晚会，是因为他去了机场给朋友送行。

airport.en: The plane landed at Heathrow Airport.
airport.zh: 飞机降落在希思罗机场。

airy.en: All the hotel’s bedrooms are light and airy.
airy.zh: 这家酒店的所有客房都明亮通风。

airy.en: He dismissed her concerns with an airy wave of the hand.
airy.zh: 他漫不经心地挥一下手，对她的忧虑不屑一顾。

aisle.en: Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat (=seat next to the aisle)?
aisle.zh: 您想要靠窗的座位还是靠过道的座位？

akin.en: Something akin to panic overwhelmed him.
akin.zh: 一种近似惊恐的感觉使他不知所措。

alarm.en: give/raise/sound the alarm We were much alarmed by the fire in the forest.
alarm.zh: 发出警报森林失火使我们大为惊慌。

alarm.en: I gave the alarm as soon as I saw the smoke.
alarm.zh: 我一看到冒烟就马上发出了警报。

alarm.en: I forgot to set the burglar alarm.
alarm.zh: 我忘记打开防盗警报器了。

alarm.en: Car alarms are always going off in the street.
alarm.zh: 街上总有汽车警报器在响。

alarm.en: He turned off the alarm and went back to sleep.
The album reminded her of the days when she was free from all worries.
alarm.zh: Ⅲ *album/?lbom/ n.(相册、集邮本等)粘贴簿；

alarming.en: The rainforest is disappearing at an alarming rate.
alarming.zh: 热带雨林在以惊人的速度消失。

alas.zh: 唐纳德去年不幸去世了。

album.en: The band plan to release their new album next week.
album.zh: 该乐队计划下周发行他们的新专辑。

alcohol.en: We should clean our hands with soap and water or alcohol-based handrub when we get home.
alcohol.zh: 到家时，我们应该用肥皂或含酒精的洗手液洗手。

alert.en: A national police alert was in effect.
The authorities were alerted to the danger.
The animal raised its head, suddenly alert.
alert.zh: 那只动物突然警觉地抬起头来。

alert.en: Taking notes is one of the best ways to stay alert in lectures.
alert.zh: 记笔记是听课时集中注意力的最佳方法之一。

alert.en: You should be alert to danger.
alert.zh: 你应该对危险保持警惕。

alertness.en: The animal raised its head, suddenly alert.
alertness.zh: 那只动物突然警觉地抬起头来。

alertness.en: Taking notes is one of the best ways to stay alert in lectures.
alertness.zh: 记笔记是听课时集中注意力的最佳方法之一。

alien.en: In those days people from other countries rarely came to Japan.
alien.zh: 那个时候，很少有外国人到日本来。

alienate.en: The latest tax proposals will alienate many voters.
alienate.zh: 最新的纳税提案将失去远许多选民的支持。

alienate.en: He felt that his experiences had alienated him from society.
alienate.zh: 他感到自己的经历令他与社会格格不入。

alienation.en: Unemployment may provoke a sense of alienation from society.
alienation.zh: 失业可能会引起不容于社会的感觉。

alight.en: The car was set alight and pushed over a hill.
alight.zh: 那辆汽车被点燃后就被推下山去。

alight.en: The car had been deliberately set on fire.
alight.zh: 这辆车被人蓄意纵火焚烧。

align.en: Church leaders have aligned themselves with the opposition.
align.zh: 教会领袖和反对派站在同一阵线上。

align.en: The desks were neatly aligned in rows.
align.zh: 书桌一行行排得整整齐齐。

alignment.en: The wheels were out of alignment.
alignment.zh: 车轮偏位，不在一条直线上。

alike.en: The twin brothers are very much alike in appearance but totally different in personality.
alike.zh: 这对孪生兄弟在外貌上非常相似，在性格上却截然不同。

alike.en: My mother and I are alike in many ways.
alike.zh: 我和母亲在许多方面很相似。

alike.en: Andrew and his father walk alike.
alike.zh: 安德鲁和他父亲走路一个样子。

alive.en: The team's hopes for the championship were still alive.
alive.zh: 团队获胜的希望仍存在。

alive.en: It was a bad accident – they’re lucky to be alive.

alive.zh: 我的祖父母和外祖父母都还健在。

all.en: Almost all students are busy preparing for the coming final exam.
all.zh: 几乎所有学生都忙着为即将到来的期末考试做准备。

all.en: She gave her all to the project, working day and night.
all.zh: 她为这个项目付出了一切，日夜工作。

all.en: It is known to all that he is ambitious for fame She gave her all to the project, working day and night.
all.zh: 他野心勃勃想要出名，这是人所共知的。

all.en: He had worked all his life in the mine.
all.zh: 他在矿场工作了一辈子。

all.en: Have you done all your homework?

all over.en: He was very well thought of all over the district.
all over.zh: 他在整个地区评价很高。

all right.en: All right, I accept your apology.

all the way.en: Did you run all the way here?

allay.en: The president made a statement to allay public anxiety.
allay.zh: 总统发表了一项声明以缓解公众的忧虑。

allegation.en: Mr Singh has strongly denied the allegations of sexual harassment.
allegation.zh: 辛格先生强烈否认性骚扰的指控。

allegation.en: The teacher made serious allegations against a colleague.
allegation.zh: 那位老师对一位同事提出严重指控。

allege.en: The prosecution alleged that the man had been responsible for an act of terrorism.
allege.zh: 控方指控那名男子发起了一次恐怖主义行动。

allege.en: It was alleged that the policeman had accepted bribes.
allege.zh: 有人声称这名警察收受贿赂。

alleged.en: The alleged victim made the complaint at a police station in York.
alleged.zh: 那位自称是受害者的人在约克一家警察局报了案。

allegiance.en: You owe allegiance (=have a duty to give allegiance) to your king.
I pledge allegiance to the flag of the United States of America.
allegiance.zh: 我向美国国旗宣誓效忠。

allergic.en: Most men are allergic to housework!
allergic.zh: 大多数男人都对做家务过敏！

allergy.en: I have an allergy to cats.

alley.en: She found the side alley where the stage door was located.
alley.zh: 她找到了剧场后门所在的小巷。

alley.en: The alley led to the railway bridge.

alliance.en: Britain’s military alliance with her NATO partners
alliance.zh: 英国与其北约伙伴的军事联盟

alliance.en: The companies have formed an alliance to market the product.
alliance.zh: 各家公司联手将该产品推向市场。

allied.en: Anthropology is closely allied to the field of psychology.
allied.zh: 人类学与心理学领域紧密关联。

allocate.en: You should allocate the same amount of time to each question.
allocate.zh: 你应当给每个问题分配相同的时间。

allocate.en: One million dollars was allocated for disaster relief.

allocation.en: Twelve hours a week seemed a generous allocation of your time.

allot.en: Try and allot two or three hours a day to revision.
allot.zh: 每天设法抽出两三个小时复习。

allot.en: Each school will be allotted twenty seats.

allotment.en: The budget allotment for each county is below what is needed.
allotment.zh: 分配给每个县的预算低于所需。

allow.en: Please allow me to tell an interesting story before the lesson.
allow.zh: 请允许我在上课前先讲一个有趣的故事。

allow.en: My parents wouldn’t allow me to go to the party.
allow.zh: 父母不许我去参加聚会。

allow.en: Are dictionaries allowed in the exam?

allowance.en: Do you get an allowance for clothes?
Many children first learn the value of money by receiving an allowance.
allowance.zh: 很多孩子首先通过领取零花钱来学习金钱的价值。

allowance.en: His father gives him a monthly allowance of £200.

alloy.en: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.

allude.en: Rick didn’t want to discuss his past, though he alluded darkly to ‘some bad things that happened.’
allude.zh: 里克不想谈论自己的过去，不过他曾伤感地暗示“

allusion.en: The committee made no allusion to the former president in its report.
allusion.zh: 委员会在报告中没有影射前总统。

allusion.en: Eliot’s poetry is full of biblical allusions.
allusion.zh: 艾略特的诗作中圣经典故比比皆是。

ally.en: She knew she had found an ally in Ted.
ally.zh: 她知道泰德已经是她的盟友了。

ally.en: Ridley was one of the Queen’s closest allies.
ally.zh: 里德利是女王最亲密的盟友之一。

almond.en: Stir in the ground almonds and egg.
almond.zh: 拌入碾碎的扁桃仁和鸡蛋。

almost.en: Almost everyone came inevitably down with the virus.
almost.zh: 几乎所有人都不可避免地因这种病毒而病倒。

aloft.en: He emerged, holding a baby aloft.
aloft.zh: 他高举着一个小宝宝出现了。

alone.en: I am not alone in this opinion.
alone.zh: 不只是我一个人有这想法。

alone.en: The book alone will bring him lasting reputation.
alone.zh: 仅仅那本书就可以让他流芳百世。

alone.en: My wife and I like to spend time alone together away from the kids.
alone.zh: 我和妻子喜欢没有孩子打扰，过二人世界。

alone.en: You shouldn’t leave a child alone in the house.
alone.zh: 你不应该把小孩独自留在家里。

along.en: You’re welcome to come along if you like.
along.zh: 你愿意的话可以一起去。

along.en: Walking slowly along the Bund, you can appreciate all kinds of European architecture.
along.zh: 沿外滩一路缓步走来，你可以欣赏到各种风格的欧式建筑。

along.en: He sang loudly as he walked along.
along.zh: 他边向前走边大声唱着歌。

along.en: I was driving along, thinking about Chris.
along.zh: 我一边开车，一边想着克里斯。

alongside.en: The two ships lay alongside of each other.
The car drew up alongside the road.
Children’s prices are shown alongside adult prices.
alongside.zh: 儿童票价标在成人票价旁边。
一辆车在旁边停了下来。

aloof.en: They worked hard, but tended to stay aloof from the local inhabitants.
aloof.zh: 他们工作努力，但是一般不和当地居民来往。

aloof.en: She had always kept herself aloof from the boys in class.
aloof.zh: 她对班上的男生一直很冷漠。

aloud.en: Joanne, would you read the poem aloud?
aloud.zh: 乔安妮，你来朗诵这首诗好吗？

aloud.en: The pain made him cry aloud.

alpha.en: Collective bargaining was viewed as the alpha and omega of trade unionism.
alpha.zh: 集体谈判被视为工会主义的全部法宝。

alphabet.en: There are 26 letters in the English alphabet.
alphabet.zh: 英语字母表中有26个字母。

alphabetic.en: The files are arranged in alphabetical order.
alphabetic.zh: 这些文件按字母顺序排列。
这些记录是以字母顺序归档的吗？

alphabetical.en: The files are arranged in alphabetical order.
alphabetical.zh: 这些文件按字母顺序排列。
这些记录是以字母顺序归档的吗？

alphabetically.zh: 这些记录是以字母顺序归档的吗？

alphabetically.en: The files are arranged in alphabetical order.
alphabetically.zh: 这些文件按字母顺序排列。

already.en: There is no need for you to tell me the truth, for I have already known it.
already.zh: 你没必要告诉我真相，因为我已知晓。

already.en: The design of the new house is similar to those that have already been built.
already.zh: 新房的设计与那些已建好的房子相似。

already.en: The performance had already started when we arrived.
already.zh: 我们到达时表演已经开始了。

also.en: Information is also available on women’s health care.
also.zh: 还可以获得有关女性保健方面的资料。

also.en: he also drove a police car allthe way to the border.
She sings beautifully and also plays the flute and piano.
also.zh: 她歌唱得好，而且还会吹长笛和弹钢琴。

also?.en: Not only did that suspect escape from the police station successfully, but he also drove a police car allthe way to the border.
also?.zh: 那个嫌犯不仅成功地从警局逃脱了，而且开着警车一路跑到边境。

alter.en: Her face hadn’t altered much over the years.
alter.zh: 过了这么多年，她的容貌并没有多大改变。

alter.en: The city centre has altered beyond recognition (=changed very much).
alter.zh: 市中心变得都认不出来了。

alteration.en: If you make alterations to the Windows setup, save the new settings before closing.
alteration.zh: 如果更改了视窗操作系统的设置，关闭前要保存新的设置。

alteration.en: Have you noticed any alteration in the patient’s behaviour?
alteration.zh: 你有没有注意到病人的行为有什么改变？

alternate.en: Arrange the leeks and noodles in alternate layers.
alternate.zh: 一层韭葱、一层面条地交替放置。

alternate.zh: 这个服务机构隔天开放一次。

alternation.zh: 一层韭葱、一层面条地交替放置。

alternation.en: The service runs on alternate days.
alternation.zh: 这个服务机构隔天开放一次。

alternative.zh: 你们在开发替代能源方面投入了多少时间?目前该公司别无选择，只好放弃了那个项目。

alternative.en: How much of your time is spent on developing alternative sources of energy?
alternative.zh: 你们在开发替代能源方面投入了多少时间?目前该公司别无选择，只好放弃了那个项目。

alternative.en: An alternative route is along the Via Unione.
alternative.zh: 另一条路线是沿着联合路走。

although.en: Although this product is in favour of environmental protection,few people show interest in it because of its high price.
although.zh: 虽然这种产品有利环保，但因其价格昂贵，几乎无人问津。

although.en: Although in poor health, she continued to carry out her duties.
although.zh: 尽管身体不好，她仍继续执行任务。

although.en: We decided to take rooms in Longwood House, although we knew we could not really afford the rent.
although.zh: 虽然我们知道自己其实付不起租金，但还是决定住朗伍德庄园的房间。

altitude.en: At high altitudes it is difficult to get enough oxygen.
altitude.zh: 在海拔高的地方很难呼吸到足够的氧气。

altitude.en: We’re flying at an altitude of 40,000 feet.
altitude.zh: 我们的飞行高度为四万英尺。

altogether.en: In Canada, the situation is altogether different.
altogether.zh: 在加拿大，情况完全不一样。

altogether.en: He's not altogether sure what to do.
altogether.zh: 他并不完全清楚该做什么。

altogether.en: Congress could ban the procession altogether.
altogether.zh: 国会可以完全禁止这次游行。

always.en: If you always go your own way, you will have to pay for what you have done.
always.zh: 如果你总是一意孤行，你将为你的所作所为付出代价。

always.en: Always lock your bicycle to something secure.
always.zh: 每次都要把自行车锁在牢固的物体上。

always.en: She’d always assumed that Gabriel was a girl’s name.
always.zh: 她一直认为加布里埃尔是个女孩名字。

amalgamate.en: The agency is expected to amalgamate with the National Rivers Authority.
amalgamate.zh: 这个机构预计会与国家河流管理局合并。

amalgamate.en: Stir until the ingredients are amalgamated.

amass.en: He amassed a fortune after the war.
amass.zh: 战后，他积累了大量财富。

amass.en: For 25 years, Darwin amassed evidence to support his theories.

amateur.en: We made a rather amateur job of painting the house.
amateur.zh: 我们把房子油漆了一遍，漆得很不在行。

amateur.en: These photos were taken by both amateurs and professionals.
amateur.zh: 这些照片是由业余爱好者和专业摄影师拍摄的。

amateur.en: Mickelson won his first major golf tournament while still an amateur.
amateur.zh: 米克尔森还是业余选手时就赢得了他第一个高尔夫球锦标赛大奖。

amateur.en: You English are a bunch of amateurs when it comes to romance.
amateur.zh: 谈情说爱你们英国人就外行了。

amaze.en: Standing at the top of the mountain and looking as far as the eye can see, we are amazed at the magnificence of nature.
amaze.zh: 站在山顶，极目远望，大自然的壮美让我们惊叹不已。

amaze.en: Dave amazed his friends by suddenly getting married.
amaze.zh: 戴夫突然结婚，令朋友们非常吃惊。

amaze.en: It still amazes me how much she has improved.
amaze.zh: 她进步很大，至今仍让我惊讶。

amaze.en: we are amazed at the magnificence of nature.
amaze.zh: 站在山顶，极目远望，大自然的壮美让我们惊叹不已。

amazed.en: She was amazed how little he had changed.
amazed.zh: 她惊诧的是他竞然没怎么变。

amazement.en: To everyone’s amazement, the goal was disallowed.
amazement.zh: 令大家吃惊的是，进球被判无效。
拉尔夫吃惊得倒抽了一口气。

amazing.en: He’s an amazing player to watch.
amazing.zh: 看他比赛那才叫精彩呢。

amazing.en: It’s amazing how often you see drivers using mobile phones.
amazing.zh: 常常看到司机在打手机，真让人难以置信。

amazing.en: She has amazing powers of recall.

amazingly.en: He’s an amazing player to watch.
amazingly.zh: 看他比赛那才叫精彩呢。

amazingly.en: It’s amazing how often you see drivers using mobile phones.
amazingly.zh: 常常看到司机在打手机，真让人难以置信。

ambassador.en: He has made some good films and he is a good ambassador for the industry.
ambassador.zh: 他拍摄过一些好电影，是这个行业的杰出代表。

ambience.en: The restaurant’s new owners have created a welcoming ambience.
ambience.zh: 这家餐厅的新主人营造出一种舒适的气氛。

ambiguity.en: There was an element of ambiguity in the president’s reply.
ambiguity.zh: 总统的回答有点模棱两可。

ambiguous.en: His role in the affair is ambiguous.
ambiguous.zh: 他在这起事件中的角色并不明确。

ambiguous.en: The language in the Minister’s statement is highly ambiguous.
ambiguous.zh: 部长的声明措辞很含糊。

ambition.en: She had always had an ambition to be a pilot.
His ambition is to be an English teacher.
ambition.zh: 他的志向是成为一名英语老师。

ambition.en: His ambition to win Nobel Prize is not likely to be realised.
ambition.zh: 他想获得诺贝尔奖的愿望不大可能实现。

ambition.en: An injury ended his ambitions of becoming a professional footballer.
ambition.zh: 一次受伤使得他当职业足球员的理想落空了。

ambitious.en: One may be poor but never ceases to be ambitious.
Alfred was intensely ambitious, obsessed with the idea of becoming rich.
ambitious.zh: 艾尔弗雷德雄心勃勃，一心想着发财。

ambivalent.en: We are both somewhat ambivalent about having a child.
ambivalent.zh: 我们两人对于生孩子这件事心情都有点矛盾。

ambivalent.en: O'Neill had a genuine ambivalence toward US involvement in the war.
ambivalent.zh: 对于美国参战，奥尼尔内心很矛盾。

ambulance.en: We called an ambulance immediately when he fainted.
ambulance.zh: 他晕过去后我们马上叫了救护车。

ambulance.en: The ambulance crew removed him from the wreckage.
ambulance.zh: 救护车上的人员将他从残骸中移出来。

ambulance.en: Mike had to be taken by ambulance to hospital.
ambulance.zh: 不得不用救护车把迈克送往医院。

ameliorate.en: It is not clear what can be done to ameliorate the situation.
ameliorate.zh: 可以采取什么办法来改善局面并不明确。

amenable.en: She was always a very amenable child.
amenable.zh: 她一向是个很听话的孩子。

amenable.en: Young people are more amenable than older citizens to the idea of immigration.

competence.zh: 学生们将学到多种技能。

competition.zh: 随着大学生人数的激增，就业竞争越来越激烈。

competition.zh: 为了得到母亲的关注，有时孩子之间会争得很厉害。

competition.en: Competition for the job was intense.

competitive.en: When we step into society one day,we should learn to get accustomed to the fiercely competitive social life.
competitive.zh: 当我们踏入社会时，要学会适应竞争激烈的社会生活。

competitive.zh: 这支球队近来好像丧失了竞争优势。

complain.zh: 她已经明白了，抱怨过去的失败是没有用的，要面对现实。

complain.zh: 人们总是抱怨大公司不友善，不愿提供帮助。

complain.zh: 她抱怨说没人到机场去接她。

complain.zh: 由于这个地区的交通流量有所增加，居民都在抱怨。

complain about.en: He never complained about working overtime.

complaint.en: If you wish to make a complaint, you should see the manager.
complaint.zh: 如果你要投诉，应该去找经理。

complaint.en: A person must realise his strong and weak points before he can reasonably set up the goal for life and struggle for it without regrets or complaints.
complaint.zh: 一个人必须清楚地意识到自己的长处和短处之后，才能合理地制定人生目标，无怨无悔地为之奋斗。

complaint.en: set up the goal for life and struggle for it without regrets or complaints.
complaint.zh: 生目标，无怨无悔地为之奋斗。

complaint.zh: 售货员都受过培训，要以友好的态度处理顾客的投诉。

complement.en: The dark red walls complement the red leather chairs.
complement.zh: 深红色的墙和红色的皮椅很相配。

complement.zh: 约翰和鲍勃互相配合得很好。

complete.zh: 直到完成了任务，他才发现时间已经到了午夜。

complete.en: Their engagement came as a complete surprise to me.
complete.zh: 他们的订婚让我感到非常意外。

completely.en: I completely agree that healthy living habits help people balance work and play.
completely.zh: 我完全赞同健康的生活习惯有助于人们平衡工作与娱乐。

completely.en: He had never completely recovered from his illness.
completely.zh: 他病后一直没有完全康复。

completely.zh: 我完全忘了今天是他的生日。

completion.en: The project is taking a long time but is now nearing completion.
completion.zh: 这个项目耗时很长，但现在就快结束了。

The house is nearing completion (=almost finished).

complex.en: a complex situation The complex opens to the public tomorrow.
complex.zh: 复杂的情况这幢综合大楼将于明天对公众开放。

complex.en: The complex opens to the public tomorrow.
complex.zh: 这幢综合大楼将于明天对公众开放。

complex.en: Peter seemed to have an instant understanding of the most complex issues.
complex.zh: 再复杂的问题彼得似乎也是一看就明白。

complex.en: Photosynthesis is a highly complex process.
complex.zh: 光合作用是一个非常复杂的过程。

complicate.zh: 我周五还得加班，这样一来事情更复杂了。

complicate.zh: 使事情更复杂的是在司法体系、贸易惯例和语言方面存在差异。

complication.zh: 飞机误点给我们的旅行带来了更大的麻烦。

complication.zh: 肺炎是卧床病人所面临的常见并发症之一。

compliment.zh: 所有客人都对她赞不绝口。

compliment.zh: 能和阿巴乐队相提并论是极大的赞誉。

concede.zh: 我承认自己犯了一些错误。

concede.zh: 格鲁吉亚军队奋起保卫首都，但最终被迫投降。

conceit.zh: 他的布道用了大量的双关语和巧妙比喻。

conceive.zh: 许多人无法想象正餐怎么可以没有肉或鱼。

concentrate.zh: 安静点，让我专心做家庭作业。

concentrate.zh: 只要你专心学习，一定能通过考试。

concentrate.zh: 阿德里安觉得自己很难集中注意力。

concentrated.zh: 他集中精力把工作做得更好。

concern.zh: 近来犯罪增多是民众极为关切的事。

concern.zh: 极右分子的活动引起关注已经有一段时间了。

concerned.zh: 离婚是非常痛苦的，涉及孩子的话更是如此。

concerned.zh: 涉及的农民当中，有些人因低价受到的损失尤为惨重。

concerning.en: I’ve already written to him about the problem.

scotch.zh: 他发表了一项声明，驳斥有关他已经死亡的谣言。

scout.zh: 他派出三名侦察兵到前面侦察大桥的情况。

scout.en: He was spotted by a scout at the age of 13.

scowl.zh: 帕特里克一脸不悦，但还是照办了。

scowl.zh: 妈妈瞪着他，一句话也不肯说。

scramble.zh: 她以最快的速度爬下树。

scream.en: They heard a scream for help at a distance.
scream.zh: 他们听到稍远处的尖叫求援声。

scream.zh: 几声枪响过后，人们开始尖叫起来。

scream.zh: 她吓得尖叫一声，跳了起来。

scream.en: She screamed at me in anger.
scream.zh: 她愤怒地对我尖声喊叫。

screech.zh: 她尖叫着要我脱掉沾满泥污的鞋子。

screen.en: You can see him on the TV screen quite often.
screen.zh: 你可以经常在电视屏幕上见到他。

screen.en: He went on staring at the TV screen.
screen.zh: 他继续盯着电视屏幕看。

screen.en: Her picture appeared on the screen.
screen.zh: 她的照片出现在屏幕上。

screening.en: He went on staring at the TV screen.
screening.zh: 他继续盯着电视屏幕看。

screening.en: Her picture appeared on the screen.
screening.zh: 她的照片出现在屏幕上。

screw.zh: 把框子固定在正确位置上，拧紧螺丝。

screw.zh: 政府开始打压不法证券商。

script.zh: 他们所有的剧本都是自己写的。

scroll.zh: 请你往下滚动几行好吗？
他在屏幕上把这份文件从头到尾滚动读了一遍。

scrub.en: She was on her hands and knees scrubbing the floor.
He scrubbed the dirt off his boots.
scrub.zh: 他把靴子上的脏土擦掉。

scruple.en: He had no scruples about selling faulty goods to people.
scruple.zh: 他卖次货给人，心里没有丝毫不安。

scruple.en: They made thousands of families homeless without scruple.
scruple.zh: 他们肆无忌惮，令成千上万的家庭流离失所。

scrupulous.en: Not all lawyers are as scrupulous as she is.
scrupulous.zh: 并不是所有的律师都像她那样正直。

scrupulous.en: The organization will be scrupulous in maintaining the highest moral standards.
scrupulous.zh: 本组织将力求保持最高的道德标准。

scrutiny.en: Their activities have come under police scrutiny.
scrutiny.zh: 他们的活动受到警方的严密监视。

scrutiny.en: Careful scrutiny of the company’s accounts revealed a whole series of errors.
scrutiny.zh: 仔细查看公司的账目，有一连串的错误被发现。

sculpture.en: You might think that art means only paintings or sculpture.
sculpture.zh: 你可能认为艺术只意味着绘画或雕塑。

scum.en: People like that are the scum of the earth.
Scum like that should be locked away!
scum.zh: 像这种人渣应该关起来！

scurry.en: People were scurrying off to work.
scurry.zh: 人们急匆匆赶着去上班。

sea.en: young people, I still prefer fishing on the sea.
sea.zh: 受年轻人欢迎，我还是偏爱海钓。(松江)

sea.en: Honestly speaking, despite the widespread popularity of city walk with young people, I still prefer fishing on the sea.
sea.zh: 说实话，尽管城市漫步广受年轻人欢迎，我还是偏爱海钓。

sea.en: Jay stripped his clothes off and ran into the sea.
sea.zh: 杰伊脱光衣服奔入海里。

sea.en: Most exports went by sea (=on a ship).
sea.zh: 大部分出口商品都走海路。

seafood.en: There's an excellent seafood restaurant near here.
seafood.zh: 离这儿不远有一家非常不错的海鲜馆。

seal.en: Write your letter and seal it in a blank envelope.
seal.zh: 信写好后把它装进空白信封里封好。

seal.en: A number of employers have already given their seal of approval to the scheme.
seal.zh: 一些雇主已经对这项计划表示认可。

seal.en: Check seals on fridges and freezers regularly.
seal.zh: 定期检查冰箱和冷冻柜的密封装置。

seal.en: The document carried the seal of the governor’s office.
seal.zh: 文件上盖有州长办公室的章。

seam.en: She was repairing Billy’s trousers, where the seam had come undone.
seam.zh: 她在补比利裤子的开线处。

sear.zh: 高温灼伤了他们的皮肤。

search.en: Two more bodies were found after a search of the woods.
search.zh: 搜寻树林以后，又找到了两具尸体。

search.en: Bad weather is hampering the search for survivors.
search.zh: 恶劣的天气妨碍了对幸存者的搜寻。

search.zh: 警方搜查了凶犯居住过的屋子，但一无所获。
警方搜查了凶犯居住过的屋子，但一无所获。

search for.en: They searched all the drawers for the missing paper.
search for.zh: 他们翻了所有的抽屉找寻那份遗失的文件。

search?.en: The police searched the house in which the murderer had once lived and found nothing.
search?.zh: 警方搜查了凶犯居住过的屋子，但一无所获。

seaside.en: We are going to the seaside for our holiday.

season.en: Some footpaths are closed during the shooting season.
season.zh: 在狩猎季节，一些人行小道会被封闭。
春天是我最喜欢的季节。

season.en: The racing season starts in June.

seat.en: I tried to seat the old lady on the bench.
seat.zh: 我试图让那个老妇人坐在长凳上。

seat.en: They have already booked the seats in the theatre.
seat.zh: 他们已经在剧院预定了座位。

seat.en: I was in the back seat and Jo was driving.
People were shifting in their seats, looking uncomfortable.
seat.zh: 人们在座位上动来动去，看上去不大自在。

secluded.en: We sunbathed on a small secluded beach.
secluded.zh: 我们在一小片僻静的海滩上晒日光浴。

secluded.en: He’s 80 years old now and lives a very secluded life.

seclusion.en: He preferred to stay at home in seclusion.
seclusion.zh: 他更喜欢安安静静地在家里待着。

seclusion.en: They enjoyed ten days of peace and seclusion.
seclusion.zh: 他们享受了十天与世隔绝的宁静生活。

second.en: For a few seconds nobody said anything.
second.zh: 有几秒钟大家都沉默无语。

second-hand.en: It may not be true – I only heard it second hand.
We got most of our furniture second hand.
second-hand.zh: 我们大部分家具都是二手货。

secondary.en: Writing was always secondary to spending time with my family.
secondary.zh: 与和我的家人共度时光相比，写作总是排在第二位。

secondary.en: Cost is the important thing – any benefits for the user are a secondary consideration.

secondhand.en: I don't think we should buy the secondhand car.
secondhand.zh: 我认为我们不应该买那辆二手车。

secondhand.en: It may not be true – I only heard it second hand.
We got most of our furniture second hand.
secondhand.zh: 我们大部分家具都是二手货。

secondly.en: Firstly, they are not efficient, and secondly, they are expensive to make.
secondly.zh: 首先，它们效率不高，其次，它们的制作成本很高。

secrecy.en: I must stress the need for absolute secrecy about the project.
secrecy.zh: 我必须强调这项计划一定要绝对保密。

secrecy.en: His work was shrouded in secrecy.

secret.en: There was a secret agreement between the two countries.
I have a secret which I mustn't tell anyone.
They kept their relationship secret from their parents.
secret.zh: 他们俩的关系瞒着父母。

secret.en: The drugs were found in a secret compartment in Campbell’s suitcase.
secret.zh: 毒品是在坎贝尔手提箱的一个秘密夹层里找到的。

secretary.zh: 我希望得到刊登在今天报纸上的秘书职位。

secretary.en: My secretary will fax you all the details.
secretary.zh: 我的秘书会把所有的细节发传真给你。

secrete.zh: 这笔钱藏匿在一个瑞士银行账户里。

secrete.en: The toad’s skin secretes a deadly poison.
secrete.zh: 蟾蜍的皮肤会分泌一种致命毒素。

secretion.en: These secretions are used by the caterpillar as a defence.
secretion.zh: 这些分泌物被毛虫用作自卫武器。

secretive.en: Carla was always very secretive about her work.
secretive.zh: 卡拉对自己的工作总是讳莫如深。

secretive.zh: 该政府被指责政务不公开、缺乏民主。

section.zh: 飞机的尾部在玉米田里找到了。

section.zh: 船只在苏格兰建造，各部分分装运往埃及。

section?.en: The chapter falls into three sections.

secure.en: The old couple lived a quiet,secure life.
secure.zh: 老夫妇俩过着平静安定的生活。

secure.zh: 博伊德的进球确保了球队进入足总杯决赛。

secure.zh: 这家公司争取到了一份2,000

securely.zh: 如今顾客可以安全放心地在网上购物了。

securely.zh: 所有的枪支都应该安全稳妥地锁到柜子里。

security.en: These security measures will remain in effect until the beginning of next month.
security.zh: 这些安全措施仍将继续实施至下月初。

security.en: The trial was held under tight security.
security.zh: 这场审讯是在戒备森严的情况下进行的。

security.en: The prison was ordered to tighten security after a prisoner escaped yesterday.
security.zh: 昨天一名囚犯越狱后，该监狱被勒令加强安全措施。

seduce.zh: 这个首席讲师因诱奸女学生而被解雇。

seductive.zh: 她使出浑身魅力来说服他。

seductive.zh: 她坐在桌子对面，朝他迷人地笑了笑。

see.zh: 看到母亲正在康复，他感觉轻松了许多。

see.zh: 我们一看到这房子就知道我们要买。

see.en: He crouched down so he couldn’t be seen.
see.zh: 他蹲下来好让别人看不见他。

see through.zh: 他说谎不高明，任何人都能识破。

see to.en: Please see to it that the packing is suitable for a long sea voyage.

see to.zh: 你来负责处理下次委员会会议的安排工作，好吗?请确保包装可以适合长途海运。

seed.en: Sow the seeds one inch deep in the soil.
seed.zh: 把种子种到一英寸深的土里。

seed.zh: 他们割了大片草地的草，然后在上面播种。

seed.en: We grew all our tomatoes from seed.
seed.zh: 我们所有的番茄都是从种子开始种的。

seek.zh: 你认为总统会谋求连任吗？

seek.en: Thousands of people crossed the border, seeking refuge from the war.
seek.zh: 成千上万的人穿过边境寻求庇护，躲避战争。

seek.zh: 我们在寻求这个问题的答案，可是没能找到。

seem.zh: 最让我担心的是，这孩子除了在线游戏之外，似乎对周围的一切都视而不见。

seem.en: It seems a foolish decision now.
seem.zh: 现在看来这是一个愚蠢的决定。
之外，似乎对周围的一切都视而不见。(松江)

seeming.en: It seems a foolish decision now.
seeming.zh: 现在看来这是一个愚蠢的决定。

seemingly.en: The new minister was faced with a seemingly impossible task.
seemingly.zh: 这位新上任的大臣面临一项似乎不可能完成的工作。

seemingly.en: Alice was standing in the street, seemingly oblivious to the rain.
seemingly.zh: 艾丽斯站在街上，似乎没有注意到天在下雨。

seep.zh: 他的紧张感逐渐消失了。

segregate.zh: 在学校里，黑人与白人是分开的。

segregate.en: The coffee room had been segregated into smoking and non-smoking areas.
segregate.zh: 咖啡室分隔成吸烟区和非吸烟区。

seize.en: We must seize every opportunity to improve ourselves.
seize.zh: 我们必须抓住每一个提升自己的机会。

seize.en: Maggie seized the letter from her.
seize.zh: 玛吉从她手上把信抢过去。

seldom.en: Seldom does he realise the importance of communicating with others.
seldom.zh: 他很少意识到与别人交流的重要性。

seldom.en: Seldom have I read an article that was so full of lies.
seldom.zh: 我很少读到这样满纸谎言的文章。

seldom.en: Karen had seldom seen him so angry.
seldom.zh: 卡伦很少见他这么生气过。

select.en: York was selected as the site for the research centre.
select.zh: 约克被选定为研究中心所在地。

select.en: He had hopes of being selected for the national team.

selection.en: He had narrowly missed selection for the team.
selection.zh: 他只差一点就入选球队了。

selection.en: The judges have made their final selection.
selection.zh: 评委已经作出最后的评选。

selective.en: We’re very selective about what we let the children watch.
selective.zh: 让孩子们看什么节目，我们挑选得很仔细。

selective.en: He has a very selective memory (=he chooses what he wants to remember and what to forget).

self.en: Jim was beginning to feel like his old self again.
self.zh: 吉姆开始感觉自己又恢复老样子了。

self.en: Sid was not his usual smiling self.
self.zh: 锡德不是平常那个笑容满面的样子。

self-disciplined.en: A lot of the kids seemed to lack self-discipline.
self-disciplined.zh: 这些小孩中有许多好像都缺乏自我约束力。

self-expression.en: Corporate dress codes don’t give workers much room for self-expression.
self-expression.zh: 公司的着装规定没有给员工多少自我表现的余地。

self-image.en: Depression affects people with a poor self-image.
self-image.zh: 自我印象差的人易得抑郁症。

self-taught.en: She received some education at night school, but was largely self-taught.
self-taught.zh: 她在夜校接受过一些教育，但主要是靠自学成材。

selfish.en: He's too selfish to think of lending me his car.
selfish.zh: 他很自私，不想把汽车借给我。

selfish.en: How can you be so selfish?

sell.en: The book written by that writer didn't sell well last year.
sell.zh: 那位作家写的这本书去年销售情况不好。

sell.en: If you offer him another hundred, I think he’ll sell.
sell.zh: 如果你再加一百元钱，我想他会卖的。

sell.en: He regrets selling all his old records.
sell.zh: 他后悔把所有的老唱片都卖掉了。

sell out.en: The shop sold out all its shirts.
sell out.zh: 那家商店的衬衫都卖光了。

seller.en: The album ‘Thriller’ remains one of the biggest sellers of all time.
seller.zh: 专辑《颤栗》依然是有史以来最畅销的唱片之一。

semblance.en: She was trying to get her thoughts back into some semblance of order.
semblance.zh: 她想稍微理出个头绪来。

semblance.en: After the war, life returned to a semblance of normality.
semblance.zh: 战后，生活稍微恢复了正常。

semicircular.en: About 50 children sat in a semicircle around me.

seminar.en: Publishers and writers from 13 countries attended the seminar.

senate.zh: 参议院批准了这项议案。

send.en: Lyn sent some pictures of the wedding.
send.zh: 琳恩寄了几张婚礼照片。

send.en: We sent Mom flowers for Mother’s Day.
send.zh: 我们在母亲节给妈妈送去了一些花。

send for.en: When the water pipes leak, we usually send for a plumber.
send for.zh: 水管漏水时，我们通常派人去请水管工。

senior.en: He is also a diplomat, but senior to me.
senior.zh: 他也是一名外交官，但级别比我高。

senior.en: He is my senior by three years.
Honours were automatically awarded to senior officials just because they were senior.
senior.zh: 荣誉顺理成章地授予资深官员，就因为他们资格老。

senior.en: White men hold most of the jobs in senior management.
senior.zh: 白人占据高级管理层的大部分职位。

seniority.en: I had 15 years seniority, and they couldn’t fire me.

sensation.zh: 心脏病发作的一个征兆是左臂有刺痛感。

sensation.en: Caroline had the sensation that she was being watched.
sensation.zh: 卡罗琳有种感觉，有人在监视她。

sensational.en: The show was a sensational success.
sensational.zh: 这次演出取得了轰动性的成功。

sense.en: A sense of panic has spread over the country.
Afterwards, I felt a great sense of relief.

senseless.en: Her death seemed such a senseless waste of life.
senseless.zh: 她的死真是无谓地浪费生命。

sensibility.en: Avoid using words that might offend someone’s racial or moral sensibilities.
sensibility.zh: 要避免使用可能会伤害种族或道德感情的词语。

sensible.en: You can improve your chances of profit by sensible planning.
sensible.zh: 你可以通过合理计划来提高盈利的机会。

sensible.en: It’s sensible to keep a note of your passport number.
sensible.zh: 把你的护照号码记下来是明智的。

sensitive.en: He's a sensitive lad and some of the criticism has stung him.
sensitive.zh: 他是个敏感的小伙子，有些批评刺痛了他。

sensitive.en: It’s made me much more sensitive to the needs of the disabled.
sensitive.zh: 它使我更加能够理解残疾人的需要。
劳拉对自己的体重很敏感。

sensitively.en: It’s made me much more sensitive to the needs of the disabled.
sensitively.zh: 它使我更加能够理解残疾人的需要。
劳拉对自己的体重很敏感。

sensitivity.en: His comments show a lack of sensitivity.
Interviewing victims of crime must be done with sensitivity.
sensitivity.zh: 与犯罪受害人谈话一定要非常小心。

sentence.en: Please make a whole sentence when answering the question. be sentenced to death
sentence.zh: 回答问题时请说完整的句子。

sentence.en: Please make a whole sentence when answering the question.
sentence.zh: 回答问题时请说完整的句子。

sentence.zh: 到句子结尾处，他压低了嗓音。

那种垃圾食品我可不吃！

shiver.en: Jake stood shivering in the cold air.
shiver.zh: 大冷天里，杰克站着冻得瑟瑟发抖。

shiver.en: She shivered with fear and anger.
shiver.zh: 她又是害怕，又是气愤，身体直发抖。

shock.en: It was a real shock to hear that the factory would have to close.
shock.zh: 听说工厂将被迫关闭，真是很震惊。

shock.en: The news of his death came as a great shock to everyone.
shock.zh: 他去世的消息让所有人都非常震惊。

shock.en: The shock of the blast shattered many windows.
shock.zh: 许多窗户在爆炸中被震碎了。

shock.en: I was shocked at the news of her passing.
shock.zh: 她去世的消息令我震惊。

shoe.zh: 你不介意我把鞋子脱了，是吧?

shoe.zh: 我坐下来脱掉鞋子和袜子。

shoot.en: With technological advancements, anyone can shoot a video and upload
shoot.zh: 随着技术进步，人人都能拍一段视频上传到平台。

shoot.en: Police shot one suspect when he pulled a gun on them.
shoot.zh: 警方在一名嫌疑人拔枪指着他们时击毙了他。

shoot.en: Smith killed his wife, and then shot himself.
shoot.zh: 史密斯杀死妻子，然后开枪自杀。

shoot?.en: With technological advancements, anyone can shoot a video and upload it to the platform.
shoot?.zh: 随着技术进步，人人都能拍一段视频上传到平台。

shop.en: We are not accustomed to seeing so many kinds of goods in the shop.
shop.zh: 商店里的商品琳琅满目，让我们无所适从。

shop.en: Shirley saw her reflection in the shop window.
shop.zh: 雪莉在商店橱窗里看到了自己的影像。

shop.en: Her brother runs a record shop in Chester.
shop.zh: 她弟弟在切斯特开了一家唱片店。

shop.en: We shopped allmorning for new coats.
shop.zh: 整个上午我们都在买新外套。

shopkeeper.en: The shopkeeper managed to keep in with his customers.
shopkeeper.zh: 店主设法同顾客搞好关系。

shopper.en: The shopper picked up the first book that he saw.
shopper.zh: 那个购物者拿起他所看到的第一本书。

shopper.en: The streets were crowded with shoppers.

shopping.en: She’s gone on a shopping trip to New York.
Late-night shopping is becoming very popular.
shopping.zh: 深夜购物越来越普遍了。

shopping mall.en: Could you tell me the way to the shopping mall?
shopping mall.zh: 你能告诉我去购物中心怎么走吗？

shore.en: We could see a boat about a mile from shore.
shore.zh: 我们看见离岸边大约一英里的地方有一艘船。

shore.en: Only a few survivors reached the shore.
shore.zh: 仅有几个生还者到达岸边。

short.en: Mary is much shorter than her mother.
Women athletes wear cropped tops and tight shorts.
short.zh: 女运动员穿着短上衣和紧身短裤。

short.en: Winter is coming and the days are getting shorter.

short-term.en: The treatment may bring short-term benefits to AIDS sufferers.
short-term.zh: 这种疗法对艾滋病患者可能会有短期效果。

short-term.en: Most of the staff are on short-term contracts.
short-term.zh: 大部分职员签的都是短期合同。

shortage.en: A shortage of professionally trained teachers has made it difficult for some schools to join the competition in Chinese language teaching.
shortage.zh: 由于缺乏受过专业训练的教师，一些学校很难加入汉语教学的竞争。

shortage.en: There is a serious shortage of food in some areas.
shortage.zh: 有些地区食物严重短缺。

shortage.en: There is no shortage of funds.

shortcoming.en: Not being punctual is his greatest shortcoming.
shortcoming.zh: 不守时是他最大的缺点。

shortcoming.en: Peter was painfully aware of his own shortcomings.
shortcoming.zh: 彼得痛苦地认识到了自己的短处。

shortcoming.en: The report suggested that there were severe shortcomings in police tactics.
shortcoming.zh: 报告暗示警方的策略存在严重缺陷。

shortcut.en: After we have experienced failure after failure,we realise that there is no shortcut in doing anything and we won't succeed unless we work hard.
shortcut.zh: 经历一次次失败之后，我们认识到做任何事情没有捷径，要成功非下苦功不可。

shortcut.en: shortcut in doing anything and we won't succeed unless we work hard.
We were late for the game, but found a short cut through the fields.
shortcut.zh: 我们没能及时赶上看球赛，但找到了一条穿过田野的近路。

shortcut.en: Carlos decided to take a short-cut home.
shortcut.zh: 卡洛斯决定抄近路回家。

shorten.en: I've asked him to shorten my trousers.
shorten.zh: 我让他把我的裤子改短点。

shorten.en: His name is often shortened to Pat.
shorten.zh: 他的名字常被简称为帕特。

shorthand.en: He’s been ‘relocated’, which is shorthand for ‘given a worse job a long way away’.
The reporter took notes in shorthand.
shorthand.zh: 这名记者用速记做记录。

shortly.en: Shortly afterwards, the police stopped the car and both men were arrested.
shortly.zh: 没过多久，警察截住了那辆汽车，两个人都被抓获了。

shortly.en: The accident happened shortly before midday.
shortly.zh: 事故是在正午前不久发生的。

shortly.en: Ms Jones will be back shortly.
shortly.zh: 琼斯女士很快就会回来。

shortly/soon after.en: Aplane crashed shortly after taking off, killing all 163 on board.
shortly/soon after.zh: 一架飞机在起飞后不久坠毁，机上163人全部丧生。

shortness.en: Winter is coming and the days are getting shorter.

shorts.en: This pair of shorts is made of real silk and is very comfortable to wear in
shorts.zh: 这条短裤是真丝做的，夏天穿起来很舒服。

shorts?.en: This pair of shorts is made of real silk and is very comfortable to wear in summer.
shorts?.zh: 这条短裤是真丝做的，夏天穿起来很舒服。

shot.en: be wounded by a shot in the leg
She was killed by a single shot to the head.
shot.zh: 她被人击中头部一枪打死。

shot.en: He pulled out his rifle and fired three shots.

should.en: We should not ask others to do what we can't do ourselves.
should.zh: 我们不应该要求别人做我们自己做不到的事情。

should.en: Children shouldn’t be allowed to play in the street.
should.zh: 不应该让儿童在街上玩。

should?.en: We should not ask others to do what we can't do ourselves.
should?.zh: 我们不应该要求别人做我们自己做不到的事情。

shoulder.en: He put his arm around her shoulders.
She tapped the driver on the shoulder.
He had to shoulder the responsibility of his father's mistakes.
shoulder.zh: 他得为他父亲的过错承担责任。

shoulder? rouldo(r).en: shoulder by shoulder He had to shoulder the responsibility of his father's mistakes.
shoulder? rouldo(r).zh: 肩并肩他得为他父亲的过错承担责任。

shout.en: A sudden shout drew the policeman's attention off, and the prisoner escaped.
shout.zh: 突如其来的一声呼喊转移了警察的注意力，犯人趁机逃跑了。

shout.en: There’s no need to shout! I can hear you!
shout.zh: 用不着大声喊叫！我听得见！

shout.en: I wish you’d stop shouting at the children.
shout.zh: 我希望你别再对孩子们大声嚷嚷了。

shove.en: Everyone was pushing and shoving to see the prince.
shove.zh: 大家都推着挤着要看王子。

shove.en: He shoved her towards the car.

shovel.en: They were out in freezing conditions shovelling snow off the pitch.
shovel.zh: 他们在外面冒着严寒铲掉球场上的雪。

shovel.en: The workmen shovelled gravel onto the road.
shovel.zh: 工人们把碎石铲到路面上。

show.en: Show your ticket to the woman at the entrance.
show.zh: 向入口处的那位女士出示你的门票。

show.en: Many people went to see the flower show.

show.zh: 她努力镇定下来，不把激动的情绪流露出来。

show.en: The children proudly showed me their presents.
show.zh: 孩子们自豪地给我看他们的礼物。

show off.en: She likes to show herself off.

show sb. around.en: Before you start to work, I'll show you around the factory.
show sb. around.zh: 开始工作前，我先领你参观一下工厂。

show up.en: More people showed up for our opening ceremony than we had expected.
show up.zh: 来参加开业典礼的人比我们预料的要多。

show?.en: Many people went to see the flower show.
She tried to calm down and not to show her excitement.
show?.zh: 她努力镇定下来，不把激动的情绪流露出来。

shower.en: be caught in a shower There wasn't time to shower or change clothes.
shower.zh: 遇到阵雨没时间淋浴或换衣服了。

shower.en: Why does the phone always ring when I’m in the shower?
shower.zh: 为什么电话铃总是在我洗澡的时候响？

shower.en: There wasn't time to shower or change clothes.
shower.zh: 没时间淋浴或换衣服了。

shower.en: I’d like to use the shower if that’s all right.
shower.zh: 如果可以的话，我想用一下这里的淋浴。

showman.zh: 他是这支乐队中风头最盛的人。

shred.en: The clothes were ripped to shreds and covered in blood.
shred.zh: 衣服被撕成了碎片，上面血迹斑斑。

shred.en: Within a year, other researchers had torn the theory to shreds.
shred.zh: 不到一年，其他研究者就把这一理论批驳得体无完肤。

shrewd.en: She was shrewd enough to guess who was responsible.
shrewd.zh: 她很精明，一猜就知道是谁干的。
马尔科姆是个精明的商人。

shriek.en: They were dragged from their homes, shrieking and weeping.
shriek.zh: 他们哭喊着被人从家里拖出去。

shrill.en: He hated the shrill demands of the children.
shrill.zh: 他对孩子们吵个不休要这要那感到很讨厌。

shrine.en: The museum is a shrine to the great Spanish artist.
shrine.zh: 这座博物馆是瞻仰这位伟大西班牙画家的圣地。

shrine.en: Elvis’ home has become a shrine for his fans.
shrine.zh: 猫王的故居成了歌迷的朝圣地。

shrink.en: I’m worried about washing that shirt in case it shrinks.
shrink.zh: 我不太敢洗那件衬衫，怕它会缩水。

shrinkage.en: Pollution led to a shrinkage of grasslands.
shrinkage.zh: 污染导致草原面积缩小。

shroud.en: The fog rolled in, and a grey shroud covered the city.
shroud.zh: 大雾滚滚而来，一张灰色的天幕笼罩着这个城市。

shroud.en: A shroud of silence surrounded the general’s death.
shroud.zh: 将军的去世让周围一片死寂。

shrug.en: I just shrugged my shoulders and ignored him.
shrug.zh: 我只是耸耸肩，没有理睬他。
他满不在乎地耸了耸肩。

shudder.en: I shudder with embarrassment whenever I think about it.
shudder.zh: 每当我想到这件事就会尴尬得直打哆嗦。

shudder.en: Maria shuddered as she stepped outside.
shudder.zh: 玛丽亚一走到外面就打了个冷战。

shuffle.en: With sore legs and aching chest, he shuffled over to the bathroom.
shuffle.zh: 他腿酸，胸口痛，拖着步子走向浴室。

shuffle.zh: 这名官员向其中一名侍者打了个手势，那个侍者便拖着脚步走上前来。

shun.en: Victims of the disease found themselves shunned by society.
shun.zh: 患这种病的人发现，社会上的人都躲着

shut.en: I heard his bedroom door shut.
shut.zh: 我听到他的卧室门关上了。

shut up.en: I wish she would shut up!

shutter.en: The company shuttered its Hong Kong business a year ago.
shutter.zh: 这家公司一年前停止了在香港的业务。

shuttle.zh: 有免费班车往返于酒店和市区之间。

shuttle.en: He took the Washington–New York shuttle.
shuttle.zh: 他乘坐华盛顿－纽约的往返班机。

shuttle.zh: 有穿梭巴士往返于圣贝内代托海滩。

shy.en: He was a quiet shy man.

shy.en: She was very shy with strangers.
shy.zh: 她在陌生人面前很害羞。

shyly.en: He was a quiet shy man.

shyness.en: He was a quiet shy man.
shyness.zh: 他是个话不多、害羞的男人。

shyness.en: She was very shy with strangers.
shyness.zh: 她在陌生人面前很害羞。

sibling.en: Most young smokers are influenced by their friends’ and older siblings’ smoking habits.
sibling.zh: 大多数年轻的吸烟者都是因为他们的朋友或者哥哥姐姐有吸烟习惯而受影响的。

sick.en: We are all sick to death of your complaints.
sick.zh: 我们对你的那些牢骚厌恶极了。

sick.en: Maria can’t come in today because she’s sick.
sick.zh: 玛丽亚因为生病今天不能来了。

sicken.en: All decent people should be sickened by such a pointless waste of life.
sicken.zh: 凡正派的人都会痛恨这样无谓地浪费生命。

sicken.en: The thought of such cruelty sickened her.
sicken.zh: 想到如此残忍的行为，她就很愤慨。

side.zh: 这个镇的南边相当破败。

side.zh: 学生们在走廊的两边摆了一些花，在墙上挂了一些漂亮的图片。

side.zh: 燃料在边境那边的法国要便宜些。

sideline.zh: 佐薇兼职做点自由摄影。

sideline.en: You can’t stay on the sidelines for ever; it’s time you got involved.
sideline.zh: 你不能一直袖手旁观，是时候参与进来了。

sidewalk.en: Don't ride your bicycle on the sidewalk.
sidewalk.zh: 别在人行道上骑自行车。

sideways.en: A strong gust of wind blew the car sideways into the ditch.
sideways.zh: 一阵狂风把汽车横着掀进了沟里。

sideways.en: They brought the piano sideways through the front door.
sideways.zh: 他们把钢琴侧着从前门抬进来。

siege.en: In June 1176, King Richard laid siege to Limoges.

siege.zh: 这次封锁历时近四个月。

sieve.en: Sieve the flour and cocoa powder into a bowl.
sieve.zh: 把面粉和可可粉筛进碗里。

sift.en: It’s hard to sift out the truth from the lies in this case.
sift.zh: 这种情况下真相和谎言难以分辨。

sift.en: Police are sifting through the evidence.

sigh.en: When he heard the news,he uttered a sigh.
sigh.zh: 听到这消息时，他叹了口气。

sigh.en: Frankie stared out of the window and sighed deeply.
sigh.zh: 弗朗基凝望着窗外，深深地叹了口气。

sigh.en: He sighed with despair at the thought of all the opportunities he had missed.
sigh.zh: 想到自己错过的一个个机会，他绝望地叹了口气。

sight.en: The sight of the photo frequently reminds the old man of his missing daughter who was lost many years ago.
sight.zh: 这张照片经常让老人想起他失踪多年的女儿。

sight.en: Anne’s sight is very good for someone of her age.
sight.zh: 安妮的视力对于她这个年龄的人来说算是非常好的。

sight.en: He began to lose his sight six years ago.
sight.zh: 六年前他开始视力衰退。

sightseeing.zh: 我们打算暑假去上海游览。

sightseeing.en: She swam and sunbathed, went sightseeing, and relaxed.
sightseeing.zh: 她游泳，晒日光浴，观光，放松。

sign.en: is a sign of power and status.
sign.zh: 有关各国都同意签署这项公约。

sign.en: The countries concerned all agreed to sign the convention.
sign.zh: 有关各国都同意签署这项公约。

sign.zh: 很多人选择在龙年生孩子，因为龙是权力和地位的标志。

sign.zh: 早晨的红霞预示着暴风雨即将来临。

sign.en: Don’t ignore the fog warning signs.

signal.en: A red light is usually a signal of danger.
signal.zh: 红灯通常是危险的信号。

signal.en: When she got up from the table, it was obviously the signal for us to leave.
signal.zh: 她从桌边站起来，这显然是要我们离开。

signal.en: We signalled a passing ship for help.
signal.zh: 我们向一艘经过的船发出了求救信号。

signal.en: At a prearranged signal the lights went out.
signal.zh: 预定的信号一发出，灯就全灭了。

signal.en: The ship signalled for a pilot.
signal.zh: 该船发信号要求派引水员来。

signature.en: Her signature is totally illegible (=cannot be read).
signature.zh: 她的签字完全无法辨认。

signature.en: The school collected 4,000 signatures for the petition.
signature.zh: 学校为这份请愿书收集到了四千个签名。

signer.en: A red morning sky is a sign of an impending storm.
signer.zh: 早晨的红霞预示着暴风雨即将来临。

signer.en: Don’t ignore the fog warning signs.

significance.en: Stella didn’t attach any significance to Doug’s query.
significance.zh: 斯特拉没有在意道格的提问。

significance.en: The book assesses the significance of Stalin’s policies between 1927 and 1939.
His words are of great significance.

significant.en: His most significant political achievement was the abolition of the death penalty.
significant.zh: 他政治上最重大的成就是废除了死刑。

significant.en: With the development of artificial intelligence,many traditional industries are facing significant challenges.
significant.zh: 随着人工智能的发展，许多传统行业正面临着巨大的挑战。

significant.en: Please inform us if there are any significant changes in your plans.
significant.zh: 你们的计划如有重大变动，请通知我们。
正面临着巨大的挑战。(徐汇)

signify.en: The image of the lion signified power and strength.
signify.zh: 狮子的形象代表权力和力量。

signify.en: Some tribes use special facial markings to signify status.
signify.zh: 有些部落使用特殊的面部标记来表示地位。

signpost.en: Just follow the signposts to the city centre.
signpost.zh: 就按路标所指的方向去市中心。

signpost.en: I’m sure that signpost is pointing the wrong way.
signpost.zh: 我敢肯定那块路标指错了方向。

silence.en: After the explosion, an eerie silence fell upon the scene.
silence.zh: 爆炸之后，现场陷入一片可怕的寂静。

silence.en: Nothing disturbed the silence of the night.
silence.zh: 没有任何声音打破这夜晚的寂静。

silent.en: He generally keeps silent at a meeting.
silent.zh: 他通常在会上保持沉默。

silent.en: The crowd fell silent (=became silent) when the president appeared.
silent.zh: 总统出现时，人群安静了下来。

silent.en: She kept silent, forcing Buchanan to continue.
silent.zh: 她保持沉默，逼着布坎南继续下去。

silent?.en: He generally keeps silent at a meeting.
silent?.zh: 他通常在会上保持沉默。

silhouette.en: The old windmill stood out in silhouette.
silhouette.zh: 那架古老风车的轮廓映衬出来。

silhouette.en: Soon the bombers would return, black silhouettes against a pale sky.
silhouette.zh: 轰炸机很快会再来，灰蒙蒙的天空又会出现一个个黑色的轮廓。

silk.en: His practice quickly grew and he took silk (=became a QC) in 1988.

silly.en: You made a lot of silly mistakes.
silly.zh: 你犯了许多愚蠢的错误。

silt.en: The old harbour silted up years ago.
silt.zh: 这个老港湾在许多年前就淤塞了。

silver.en: It was my job to polish the silver.
silver.zh: 我的工作是擦亮银餐具。

silver.en: The lake sparkled with shades of blue and silver.
silver.zh: 湖面上泛着蓝色和银白色的波光。

silvery.en: Clara gave a small, silvery laugh.
silvery.zh: 克拉拉发出一声银铃般的轻笑。

similar.en: The teaching method of this online course is very similar to that of an offline course.
similar.zh: 这个在线课程的教学方式与线下课程非常相似。

similar.en: Both approaches seem to achieve similar results.
similar.zh: 两种方法都得出了相似的结果。

similar.en: We have similar tastes in music.
similar.zh: 我们对音乐的品位相近。

similarity.en: The present crisis bears some similarity to the oil crisis of the 1970s.
There are some striking similarities between the two plays.
similarity.zh: 这两出戏有一些异常相似之处。
